source_text: Finland's National Institute for Health and Welfare stated in 2023 that non-medical male circumcision contravenes the child's right to bodily integrity, though no dedicated ban exists; a 2020 proposal to include it in female genital mutilation legislation was withdrawn following religious advocacy.
